context.protocol: Use the named outer key with a JSON object as its value. Stage protocol governs wire format; role duty governs content. Quoted values are strings; "..." denotes nonempty text or the supplied hash. In {ref,field} records, ref is an existing evidence ID and field is a fact name. Copy actual reference IDs from context, not example IDs. Only draft defines claim IDs and only review defines opinion IDs; use nonempty maps. IDs and fact names are 1–64 ASCII alphanumerics, underscores or hyphens, starting alphanumeric. Copy supplied hashes, never calculate them. Fields are required except draft claim_scope. artifact: {"draft_sha256":"...","conflict":false,"opinions":{"o1":{"claim":"c1","verdict":"support","reason":"...","missing":[]}}}; copy the hash from context.prior.draft_sha256. conflict is a boolean; verdict is support, oppose or undetermined. missing lists {ref,field} records. Review every claim and challenge its scope.
